title: Our Misfortune
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Boss

  • Kill Frump
  • Capture Frump's Lucky Charm

Quest Reward: 18000 Gold and 10 Kings Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Unknown

Tip: This is a pretty standard Boss quest. Read the guide to Frump and it should be easy.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon from Frump's Actuary in Frump's Misfortune - Level 5 and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Please, allow me to introduce myself. I am Taxman Jones and I have been assigned here by the King's Board of Trustees to Frump's Interdungeonal Resort to protect the interests of the Kingdom. You see, the Kingdom is a minority shareholder in Frump's Misfortune and it is up to me to ensure that this dungeon is profitable and holds to the standards of the King's Board of Trustees. Unfortunately it has not. The Frump's promises to the King's Board of Trustees regarding profit sharing have not been fulfilled and it is time for me to take action.

There is currently an obstacle in the way that is keeping me from being able to collect on the failed promise made by The Frump: Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon. Chapter 11 is the Chapter of The Dead Broke and The Frump has invoked it to protect himself against my debt collecting efforts. That is where you come in. I understand that you have been working on getting into The Frump's good graces in hopes of becoming The Flunky, but the Kingdom needs you.

Hunt down Frump's Actuary in Frump's Misfortune - Level 5 and relieve him of Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon so that we can begin to recoup our loses. Return to me, Taxman Jones, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when you have Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon.

Turn-in:

Hand Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon to me, Dungeon Runner. It is powerful beyond imagination! You didn't open it did you? You didn't mutter the words 'Klaatu Barada Necktie' did you? No, ok. Nevermind. Good job!

Objectives:

  • Chapter 11 of the Necronomicon ×1

Level range: 28–45
